items.title: Tim Kelly Interview, 1978-12-03
items.q: played a lot with Pete B. Lesseps, who was a very successful agent and an orchestra leader in the Warlands. We worked in the bank. ... But we played lots of jobs.

ctx.x: That's with the Owls at one time, I remember. Sure.

Could be wrong, could have been. Johnny possibly played with everybody in the room. Any number of bands, because he lived down there for a long period. He finally went to California. So Johnny, of course, helped me. I worked at Warlands. I got to meet all these musicians around New Orleans. All the jobs were booked down in front of Warlands. They weren't booked at the Union or any place. I was booked in front of Warlands. In fact, police used to have to make the guys, they would be so thick, in front of 605,…
